activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1926 as Schrödinger's representative Swiss scientific-activity year. While Professor of Theoretical Physics at the University of Zurich, he formulated and published the wave equation that became a foundation of quantum mechanics.

sources.title: Erwin Schrödinger – Nobel Prize in Physics 1933 — University of Zurich
sources.citation_text: The University of Zurich records Schrödinger as professor there from 1921 to 1927 and identifies the winter of 1925/26 and his 1926 wave-equation papers as his major breakthrough.
